name: End of the Play
author: Rackett
description: Go under the ship portal at 32% as the ufo and then navigate through the following section. At 34%, spam above the level between invisible saws and slope to skip the teleport portal. Once you can see your icon, maintain a constant position until 50% where you can then release. At 86%, touch the normal gravity portal near the ceiling, land on the blocks at 88% and then don’t click to fall to the floor. Free to the end from there.
